text:
ali: Rough sketch for benchmark launch comms. Need crisp hero stat and two supporting assets: a short explainer and a gated deep dive.

fran: Hero stat: "Up to 8-10x lower per-token serving cost on real-world slices*". Add baseline note: "single x16 A100 unoptimized".

josh: Visual trio idea: 1) condensed heatmap (cost density by slice), 2) stacked bar of per-request cost components (compute, memory, infra), 3) tail-latency small multiples. Keep hero to two visuals only.

meera: For phrasing, prefer "up to" and include an explicit footnote anchored to the repo test harness. Also include a one-line trust cue: "Full CSVs & configs available".

ali: CTA split: awareness = blog post + LinkedIn card; mid = gated deep-dive + interactive estimator; enterprise = webinar w/ live demo and post-webinar follow-up.

fran: estimator idea: tokens/day + %multi-turn -> monthly cost delta vs baseline. gate at email and company size. tag downloads as "bench-engaged" for SDR routing.

josh: demo flow for webinar: 1) 90s framing, 2) live routing split (same convo on fast path vs basic host), 3) walkthrough of cost calc, 4) 15-min audience Qs. Keep demo reproducible and short.

meera: Legal check: avoid absolutes like "guaranteed". Alternatives: "demonstrates up to" or "shows typical". I'll run copy by legal.

benchbot: uploaded: bench-2026-v2.pdf + raw-results-1751.csv -> https://rdw.in/bench-1751 (auto).

ali: Design asks: heatmap rows = slices (chat/assist/batch), cols = avg tokens per request. Color axis = $/1k tokens. Add annotation where prefix caching changes the slope.

fran: Also prepare two headline copy variants for A/B test: A) "See the numbers" B) "Estimate my inference savings". Track conversion to MQL.

josh: For the deep-dive, include appendix: model checkpoints, batch sizes, qconfig, hardware, network emulation. Transparency reduces pushback.

meera: Routing rules: blog leads -> MQL scoring, gated deep-dive -> product-qualified lead & AE follow-up, webinar registrants -> event drip + AE invite if "interested in Dedicated" checked.

ali: Action items: fran - hero copy + CTAs by Mon; meera - legal ping + gating fields; josh - appendix draft + demo script; benchbot - make CSV + PDF stable links.

sylvia: will start design comps once fran posts copy. Colorblind palette + simple legend required.

ali: cool. we'll reconvene Thur to pick final visuals and lock gating. thanks. :tada:
